value.rationale: The golden-mean hard-core subshift is a canonical constrained shift. This is a natural COMPLETE small-memory classification, separating 229 valid endomorphisms, 11 surjections, 5 reversibles and 6 first-radius noninvertible surjections. The sharp 21-word test exposes a large finite-observation blind spot (20 symbols, four times the neighborhood width) and is attained uniquely by a reversible-symmetric local rule. This precise obstruction horizon matters to image-language testing and distinguishes finite observations from genuine onto behavior; it is neither an arbitrary slice nor a mere restatement of general decidability.
